title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays is an open play night for American Mahjong in The Gallery at the Gillioz, held with Blooming Bams; you can drop in or stay the whole time, and several tile sets are provided. It is for players who already know American Mahjong with NMJL rules, at any skill level, and you should bring your own 2026 NMJL card. It runs Monday, December 7, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO, and it is free.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre
